transcript: Speaker A: Agle do hafte English bolne ki practice karo. Bas roz 15 minute. June khatam hote-hote tum English bol rahe hoge. Shuru karein? English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, shuru karna mushkil hai. To aaj hi English Seekho app download karo aur 2-week challenge lo. Pehle hafte expert videos dekho jo Hindi me English sikhate hain. Doosre hafte AI coach ke saath 24/7 practice karo. AI coach bina judge kiye aapki galtiyan sudharegi. Trial sirf ek rupaye me. No bahana. Download karo aaj hi. [Practice speaking English for the next two weeks, just 15 minutes daily. By the end of June, you will be speaking English. Start today with the English Seekho app's 2-week challenge. Watch expert videos in the first week and practice with an AI coach in the second week. The AI coach corrects you without judgment. Trial is just 1 rupee. Download today!]
on_screen_text: अगले दो हफ्ते इंग्लिश बोलने की प्रैक्टिस करो... ट्रायल सिर्फ एक रुपये। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Practice speaking English for the next two weeks... Trial for just 1 rupee. Download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A presenter on stage challenges viewers to learn English in two weeks using the English Seekho app. The program involves watching simple expert videos in the first week and practicing privately with an AI coach that corrects mistakes in the second week. Viewers are urged to start their trial for just 1 rupee.
